Game prop reference of the rock cliff face segment from the reference image, seen from the front at the game's camera angle, slightly from above. The reference shows no cliff: it is only the dark forest scene whose palette, evening light and voxel style the cliff must match; draw only one cliff and nothing else, no trees, no figures; use the reference rocks only for the colours of the stone. Same design: a steep wall of rough grey-brown stone in chunky blocky ledges and cracks, darker in the cracks, lighter on the lit top edge, a few tufts of dark grass on the ledges, the strip much wider than it is tall. A seamless tiling rock texture for one 44 px cliff step. Match the rendering style of the second reference image exactly: the same chunky voxel pixel-art look, block size, outline-free shading and soft lighting, but not its subject. A seamless tiling rock texture for one 44 px step of the cliff. The left edge continues the right edge and the top edge continues the bottom. Not a freestanding block and not a pillar. Plain flat white background, no ground, no grass, no shadow, no text, no other objects. One single rock cliff face segment only, not a sheet of several.

Game prop reference of the broadleaf tree from the reference image, seen from the front at the game's camera angle, slightly from above. A tall narrow poplar, a column of leaves on a slim trunk, a different silhouette from the round oak, not a smaller copy of it. Match the rendering style of the second reference image exactly: the same chunky voxel pixel-art look, block size, outline-free shading and soft lighting, but not its subject. The whole broadleaf tree from its top to the ground it stands on, upright, centred, nothing cropped. Plain flat white background, no ground, no grass, no shadow, no text, no other objects. One single broadleaf tree only, not a sheet of several.
